name: STANLEY 70-964 Shallow Offset Bi-Hex Ring Spanner Set (12 Pieces, 6-32mm)
shortDescription: Professional 12-piece drop-forged Chrome Vanadium steel shallow offset bi-hex ring spanner set spanning 6mm to 32mm in a heavy-duty vinyl roll-up pouch.
overview: The STANLEY 70-964 ring spanner set delivers exceptional fastener turning torque and clearance in restricted engine compartments, pipe manifolds, and structural flanges. Forged from premium Chrome Vanadium (Cr-V) alloy steel and heat-treated to exacting tolerances, each spanner features 75-degree shallow-offset heads that elevate the technician's knuckles away from obstructing obstructions. The precision broached 12-point Maxi-Drive bi-hex profile grips fastener flats rather than corners, reducing fastener rounding and enabling higher torque transmission.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive 12-piece set covering sizes: 6x7, 8x9, 10x11, 12x13, 14x15, 16x17, 18x19, 20x22, 21x23, 24x27, 25x28, and 30x32 mm
Drop forged from high grade Chrome Vanadium (Cr-V) steel for maximum torsional strength
Maxi-Drive 12-point ring geometry contacts fastener flats to prevent corner rounding
75° shallow offset head provides optimal knuckle clearance over protruding flanges
Satin chrome micro-matte finish resists rust, chemical corrosion, and oil slipping
Precision heat treated conforming strictly to DIN 838 and ISO 3318 specifications
Includes heavy-duty reinforced roll-up storage wallet with dedicated size slots
